title_en: Villa - For Sale - Elysium Residence, Tirana(ID: 530181095-229)
description_en: LUXURY VILLA FOR SALE – ELYSIUM RESIDENCE! 🏡 ATTACHED, LUXURIOUS VILLA FOR SALE ELISIUM RESIDENCE, NEAR TEG! In one of the most sought after and elite residences of Tirana, Elisium Residence, this attached villa is offered for sale, with a modern style and exceptional investment. Land area: 355 m², Building area: 304 m², Veranda: 22 m², Private green yard, 4 spacious bedrooms, where from the rooms on the first floor you can access a veranda where you can enjoy your afternoons. Interiors organized with style and natural light, Super quality investment in every detail (furniture, lighting, heating-cooling system, premium materials), Parking space for 4 vehicles. The residence offers 24/7 security, elite maintenance, absolute tranquility and quick access to TEG and the Great Ring Road. 📍Perfect location for those looking for luxury, comfort and privacy, just a few minutes from the center of Tirana.
